description.zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Default value: **1**.

description.zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. The maximum value of PageSize is 100. The default number of entries per page is 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
> Do not leave PageSize empty.

description.zh: 指定要查询的AccessKey ID。仅支持精确查询。
description.en: The AccessKey ID that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
>调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the member account in the resource directory (Alibaba Cloud account).
> You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh: 指定要查询的泄露信息的发现时间，可以查询该时间点后发现的所有AccessKey泄露信息。该参数为时间戳格式，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The discovery time of the leaked information that you want to query. All AccessKey leak information discovered after this point in time is returned. This parameter is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
指定要查询的已泄露的AccessKey信息的处理状态。取值：
- **pending**：未处理
- **dealed**：已处理
description.en:
The processing status of the leaked AccessKey information that you want to query. Valid values:
- **pending**: unprocessed
- **dealed**: processed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-accesskey-leak-list --status pending --query yourAccessKeyID --start-ts 1614155361489 --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeAccesskeyLeakList --region cn-hangzhou --Status pending --StartTs 1614155361489 --Query yourAccessKeyID --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 12324284232340000
